title: Better Craftable Bells
description: Adds the ability to craft the bell using any wooden slab!
body:
This datapack allows you to craft the bell using:
- 1 Wooden Slab (Any Wooden Variant)
- 2 Stone
- 1 Gold Ingot

A simple recipe to solve a simple solution, & it works with any wooden slab, doesn't matter what kind, as long as it is a wooden slab. *Includes Nether Wood & Bamboo Slabs*
